reason: The label actually passes my check: water, cold-brewed mate, fruit concentrate, no sweeteners, so I'd grab one can in a café to try it during exam week. But at 55 CZK I won't make it my regular; YEAHRBA on Rohlík does the same job for less.
objection: Every brand says natural now, and 55 CZK a can is a lot when I can get yerba mate cheaper on Rohlík with my normal grocery order.
would_change_my_mind: Getting it on Rohlík's bio section in a multipack at around 40 CZK a can, so it slots into my weekly order instead of a separate e-shop delivery.
